descriptor: Digital boarding passes with live gate updates

voice.summary: Wayfarer Wallet sounds like a seasoned gate agent who is never rattled: clear, short and one step ahead of the traveller. It gives the next thing to do before the traveller has to ask.
dos: Lead with the gate, the time and the seat
Use present tense for live updates, such as 'Boarding now'
Keep every message under ten words
donts: Use airline cheerfulness like 'Have a magical journey'
Hide a delay behind soft wording
Add exclamation marks to gate changes

taglines: Your pass, ready before you are
boilerplate: Wayfarer Wallet is a travel app that keeps boarding passes, gate changes and flight details in one place, so travellers can reach the aircraft without hunting through emails.

microcopy.error: We could not refresh your gate. Retrying.
microcopy.empty: No passes yet. Add a flight to begin.

logo.note: A paper plane is instantly legible on a pass and echoes the destination photography.
